title: Breast cancer
name: breast-cancer
description: Breast cancer recurrence dataset from the University Medical Centre, Institute of Oncology, Ljubljana, Yugoslavia. Contains patient attributes (age, menopausal status, tumor characteristics) and a binary recurrence class label.

licenses.name: ODC-PDDL-1.0
licenses.title: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and Licence (PDDL)

resources.name: breast-cancer
resources.description: Patient records with clinical attributes and breast cancer recurrence outcome. Each row represents one patient.

fields.name: mefalsepause
fields.description: Menopausal status: lt40 (pre-menopausal, age < 40), ge40 (post-menopausal, age >= 40), premefalse (pre-menopausal). Note: column name and value 'premefalse' are artefacts of a script bug and will be corrected to 'menopause' / 'premeno' in a future update.

fields.name: inv-falsedes
fields.description: Number of involved axillary lymph nodes (range): 0-2, 3-5, 6-8, 9-11, 12-14, 15-17, 18-20, 21-23, 24-26. Note: column name is an artefact of a script bug and will be corrected to 'inv-nodes' in a future update.

fields.name: falsede-caps
fields.description: Whether the cancer has spread to the lymph node capsule: true or false. Note: column name is an artefact of a script bug and will be corrected to 'node-caps' in a future update.

fields.name: breast-quad
fields.description: Quadrant of the breast where the tumor is located: left_up, left_low, right_up, right_low, or central.

fields.name: irradiat
fields.description: Whether the patient received radiation therapy: true or false.

fields.name: class
fields.description: Recurrence outcome: recurrence-events (cancer recurred) or false-recurrence-events (no recurrence). Note: the 'false-' prefix is an artefact of a script bug; the correct value is 'no-recurrence-events'.
